messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — hitting an odd case in the SDK where requests with only X-Project but no API-Key are being treated as unauthenticated by the ingress proxy. Can we confirm desired behavior?
jamal: hmm — what do the docs say today? I thought X-Project was just metadata, not auth.
alex: correct, API-Key is required for auth. X-Project is advisory/project-scoping only. If no key, should 401.
maria: that's what I thought too, but in prod the proxy is returning 403 in some cases (looks like our auth layer is trying org fallback and then rejecting).
olivia: do you have an example request/response?
maria: pasted log: 
```
POST /v1/generate
Headers: {"X-Project": "acme", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
Response: 403 {"error":"access denied", "reason":"no valid key found, org fallback rejected"}
```
jamal: ok two issues: 1) 403 implies authorization failure (key present but forbidden) vs 401 for missing/invalid credentials. 2) fallback logic might be treating missing API-Key as implicit org lookup then returning 403 if project not allowed.
alex: agree. We should be explicit in the contract: missing/empty API-Key => 401. Present API-Key but not allowed for X-Project => 403.
maria: will that break any clients that relied on current proxy behavior? I can run quick scan of logs for clients getting 403 today with no key.
ci-bot: scan job started for route /v1/* — searching last 30d for requests with no Authorization header that resulted in 403.
olivia: thanks — also worth checking SDK: our JS SDK currently injects clientKey from env if available; some orgs only set X-Project and expect an anon flow. We need to document anon limitations.
jamal: proposal: enforce contract now in gateway: missing key => 401. Add compatibility shim for 2 weeks that emits warning header `X-Deprecation: missing-key-defaults-to-403` and logs telemetry. Then strict 401 after the window.
alex: +1. Also add a unit/integration test for proxy that covers:
```
// tests/auth_flow.test.js
it('rejects requests without api-key with 401', async () => { /* ... */ })
```
maria: I'll open a PR for the gateway change and the shim. Assigning myself. Will also add a compatibility dashboard card showing weekly counts.
jamal: re: key rotation, double-check: rotated keys that are expired should return 401 not 403, right?
alex: yes expired/invalid => 401. 403 reserved for insufficient scope/forbidden project.
maria: noted. Also, we had one case where ingress proxy stripped `Authorization` when coming from some edge proxy. We should detect `X-Forwarded-Auth` and log a metric.
olivia: can we instead normalize at the edge and copy `X-Forwarded-Auth` -> `Authorization` if missing? Safer to log + shim for now.
jamal: add an alert if we see >50 requests/day with `X-Forwarded-Auth` present but `Authorization` missing.
ci-bot: alert rule created: auth.headers.missing_authorization_forwarded > 50/day -> notify #eng-oncall.
maria: action items: 1) PR for gateway change + deprecation header (maria) 2) unit tests (alex + maria) 3) SDK docs update about anon behavior (olivia) 4) telemetry dashboard (maria) 5) scan results + follow-up in 24h (ci-bot will post)
maria: pinging @alex @jamal @olivia for quick review when PR is up, will link ticket.
alex: will review today. :thumbsup:
jamal: lgtm. thanks for driving.
ci-bot: scan results: 124 hits in last 30d where no Authorization header returned 403 -> sending sample list to #eng-platform via DM.
maria: sample looks like third-party proxy issue for ~60% of hits, rest are SDKs misconfig. I'll triage and update the ticket.
olivia: nice. once PR merged let's add a release note and one-line API contract snippet in the docs: "Requests without API-Key are 401 Unauthorized; Authorization header required for all non-public endpoints."
maria: agreed. closing loop after PR/scan. Thanks all!"
